tags: converted from left-back to striker mid-2024 season at Forge FC, immediately prolific (10 goals in 14 games)
left Forge FC for RWD Molenbeek (Belgium, Challenger Pro League) in a CPL-record transfer, Aug 2024
two seasons in Belgium, including missing time in early 2025 after surgery
signed by Vancouver Whitecaps FC on 30 July 2026, returning to MLS/North America
originally from Brampton, Ontario; came up through Toronto FC's reserve system before joining Forge FC

public_statements: Expressed excitement over his move to RWD Molenbeek in Belgian press (SportsWorldGhana).
off_pitch.notes: Ghanaian-Canadian dual national. His CPL-record transfer to RWD Molenbeek was reportedly left partly unpaid, resulting in the Belgian club being docked points -- a notable off-pitch/institutional footnote on that transfer, not attributable to the player himself.
